name: Devel Generate Commerce
description: Generate dummy commerce products, product types, product variations, orders
project_description: Devel Generate Commerce is a development-only helper that plugs into the Devel Generate framework to bulk-create dummy Drupal Commerce content: product types (with matching variation types), products, product variations and orders. It exposes a Devel Generate settings form at admin/config/development/generate/commerce and a Drush command (devel-generate:commerce, alias gencom) so a developer can populate a store with realistic sample data in one step. Amounts, a min/max price range, a randomised created/placed time range, the order workflow and which order states to draw from are all configurable, and an optional 'kill' flag deletes all existing commerce entities before generating new ones. It requires Commerce (order, product, checkout, store, price) plus Devel and Devel Generate.
